# apu.web.id

> Homelab Engineer & AI Tinkerer — Arch Linux self-hosted infrastructure, AI gateway, and developer portfolio.

## About

Personal website and dashboard for Regsi Wahyu Saputra. Built with Next.js 16, deployed on a self-hosted Arch Linux server behind Cloudflare.

## What This Site Contains

- **Landing page**: Hero with live system stats (uptime, CPU, RAM, disk, temperature), about section, projects, work experience, and contact
- **Dashboard** (requires auth): Server monitoring, finance tracker, AI gateway management
- **Blog** (planned): Technical articles about homelab, AI, and self-hosted infrastructure

## Tech Stack

- **Server**: Arch Linux x86_64, Intel i3-7100, 8GB RAM
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, GSAP
- **AI Gateway**: 9Router (localhost:20128) — multi-provider LLM proxy
- **Agent**: Hermes — personal AI agent via Telegram/WhatsApp
- **Proxy**: Caddy → Cloudflare DNS/CDN
- **Monitoring**: Systemd services, custom health endpoints

## Key URLs

- Homepage: https://apu.web.id
- Dashboard: https://apu.web.id/dashboard (auth required)
- API Health: https://apu.web.id/api/v1/health
- System Status: https://apu.web.id/api/v1/system-status
